name: Assisting Arch Druid Runetotem
summary: The Cenarion Circle in Thunder Bluff seeks your aid in a research project led by Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem. You are asked to speak with him on Elder Rise.

sections.title: A Call for Aid
sections.body: The Cenarion Circle seeks seasoned adventurers in Thunder Bluff to help with research. Hamuul Runetotem leads the work, though its details are not yet known to you. Speak with the Arch Druid on Elder Rise.

faq.answer: The Cenarion Circle in Thunder Bluff seeks your aid with a research project led by Hamuul Runetotem.
Hamuul Runetotem is an Arch Druid leading the Cenarion Circle's research project in Thunder Bluff.

faq.q: Where can I speak with Hamuul?
faq.answer: Hamuul Runetotem is on Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff.
The Cenarion Circle has a research project led by Hamuul Runetotem, but its details are not known to you at this step.
